params.It takes care of the whole family: It’s important to know if you’re needed by your loved ones. The camera alerts you if the noise level suddenly changes – whether your baby cries or a siren blares. Even those who are not so “tech savvy” will enjoy the E6. They can start a video call to your phone by simply posing a victory sign at the camera.
params.Protection continues, even overnight: The E6 camera uses two powerful infrared lights to render sharp nighttime imaging at up to 10 meters. It can automatically switch between day and night vision as the lighting environment changes.
params.A surprisingly good audio experience: Communications are the basis of companionship, so we made the audio quality better than you’d expect.
params.Smart integration, hands-free control: Easily manage your E6 via the EZVIZ App. What’s better, by working seamlessly with voice assistants, you can voice-enable the live view to check what’s happening on a bigger screen.
params.Extented compatibility with Apple HomeKi: As EZVIZ’s first smart home security camera to fully support HomeKit, the E6 adds another layer of convenience for Apple users. You can view live cameras, get smart notifications, and set personalized automation on all your Apple devices.
params.Steady connection for boosted performanc: Set up the camera network, either wired or wirelessly. You can connect the camera to either 2.4 or 5 GHz¹ band to ensure a strong Wi-Fi signal.
params.A visual diary made of precious moments: The E6 ensures that you capture unforgettable moments and store the memories safely²
params.We do our best to protect your data: EZVIZ has been awarded by DNV forinformation security(ISO/IEC 27001:2013),personal data protection(ISO/IEC 27701:2019),cloud security(CSA STAR) and more.
params.One app for everyday, everything: EZVIZ App will always connect you to your home, even if you are far away from it.
params.Available on Phone / Pad / TV: You will need to choose the Wi-Fi frequency band during the device setup process. Once the choice is made, you will not be able to change it to another frequency band.

raw_params.It takes care of the whole family: It’s important to know if you’re needed by your loved ones. The camera alerts you if the noise level suddenly changes – whether your baby cries or a siren blares. Even those who are not so “tech savvy” will enjoy the E6. They can start a video call to your phone by simply posing a victory sign at the camera.
raw_params.Protection continues, even overnight: The E6 camera uses two powerful infrared lights to render sharp nighttime imaging at up to 10 meters. It can automatically switch between day and night vision as the lighting environment changes.
raw_params.A surprisingly good audio experience: Communications are the basis of companionship, so we made the audio quality better than you’d expect.
raw_params.Smart integration, hands-free control: Easily manage your E6 via the EZVIZ App. What’s better, by working seamlessly with voice assistants, you can voice-enable the live view to check what’s happening on a bigger screen.
raw_params.Extented compatibility with Apple HomeKi: As EZVIZ’s first smart home security camera to fully support HomeKit, the E6 adds another layer of convenience for Apple users. You can view live cameras, get smart notifications, and set personalized automation on all your Apple devices.
raw_params.Steady connection for boosted performanc: Set up the camera network, either wired or wirelessly. You can connect the camera to either 2.4 or 5 GHz¹ band to ensure a strong Wi-Fi signal.
raw_params.A visual diary made of precious moments: The E6 ensures that you capture unforgettable moments and store the memories safely²
raw_params.We do our best to protect your data: EZVIZ has been awarded by DNV forinformation security(ISO/IEC 27001:2013),personal data protection(ISO/IEC 27701:2019),cloud security(CSA STAR) and more.
raw_params.One app for everyday, everything: EZVIZ App will always connect you to your home, even if you are far away from it.
raw_params.Available on Phone / Pad / TV: You will need to choose the Wi-Fi frequency band during the device setup process. Once the choice is made, you will not be able to change it to another frequency band.

In addition to a pretty sharp IR night vision, the camera can light up the environment with two built-in spotlights to render color night vision.
params.Protection lasts, even in harsh weathers: Thanks to its well-built camera body, the H3c 2K is IP67-rated to withstand even the toughest weather conditions – whether it’s rainy, stormy or snowy.
params.Smart integration, hands-free control: You can integrate the H3c 2K to your existing smart home system. Voice-enable the live viewing with “Hey Google” or “Alexa” to check what’s happening on a bigger screen.

params.Made for the great outdoors: Wi-Fi and power can be a headache when it comes to outdoor protection. The EB8 4G changes the game by operating with a large battery and 4G network. The camera is weatherproof against rain and snow, and can stay charged using sunlight through a compatible solar panel.
params.Supports Charging via Solar, Green Energ: Know where your camera is with the built-in GPS
params.3 One click return to the preset locatio: No matter how complicated the tracking is, the camera always knows it’s way back to your preferred viewing angle. You can pinpoint up to 12 angles via the EZVIZ App. Just click on your pre-set dots and the camera will automatically resume its place.
params.Smart integration, hands-free control: Easily manage your EB8 4G via the EZVIZ App. What’s better, you can voice-enable the live viewing with “Hey Google” or “Alexa” to check what’s happening on a bigger screen.
params.We do our best to protect data and priva: EZVIZ has been awarded by DNV for information security (ISO/IEC 27001:2013), personal data protection (ISO/IEC 27701:2019), cloud security (CSA STAR) and more.
params.One app for everyday, everything: EZVIZ App will always connect you to your home, even if you are far away from it.
params.Available on Phone / Pad / TV: Please note that the EB8 4G camera only operates with a 4G network and does not work with a Wi-Fi connection. The list of supported regions and carriers is continually updated; please find the full list at ezviz.com.
